answer: By the violet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The saffron is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the timber. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work.
